teamPage.heroSubtitle: THE CREATIVE MINDS BEHIND EVERY BEAUTIFUL SPACE
teamPage.intro: We have 3 sales teams respectively serving retail customers, commercial project contractors and franchisers. Inside each team, different sales representatives are responsible for different countries and regions. We are experts in our respective fields in order to meet different type customers' needs. 3 sales teams come together in a collaborative effort to provide an excellent experience for our customer.
teamPage.statYearsLabel: Years of Excellence in Interior Solutions
teamPage.designBody: Varsovia Design collaborates with Italian designers and suppliers to enhance our global competency. We combine updated aesthetics with functionality to create exciting spaces tailored to our clients' wishes and bring lasting living pleasure.
teamPage.architectBody: Our architect and engineering team ensures structural integrity, precise technical drawings, and seamless coordination between design intent and on-site execution.
teamPage.toolsBody: Professional design tools are adopted to assist for perfect art effect, including CAXA, CAD, 3D MAX, KD MAX, etc.

qualitySale.heroSubtitle: COMMITTED TO YOUR SATISFACTION BEYOND PROJECT COMPLETION
qualitySale.heroBody: We believe exceptional interior design is backed by exceptional service. That's why our commitment continues long after project completion, offering reliable after-sales support, maintenance guidance, and prompt assistance to keep your interiors performing beautifully and maintaining their lasting value.
qualitySale.step1Desc: Reach out through phone, email, or our support form.
qualitySale.step2Desc: Our team reviews your request and identifies the best solution.
qualitySale.step3Desc: A convenient service appointment is arranged.
qualitySale.step4Desc: Our experts complete the required service efficiently and professionally.
qualitySale.faq1Q: Is my project covered under warranty?
qualitySale.faq1A: Yes. Warranty coverage depends on the products and materials used. Our team will explain all warranty details during project handover.
qualitySale.faq2Q: How can I request after-sales support?
qualitySale.faq2A: Reach us through the contact page, email, or phone. Our team will log your request and schedule a visit at the earliest convenience.
qualitySale.faq3A: We offer scheduled maintenance and check-ups for modular kitchens, wardrobes, and fitted furniture to keep everything in top condition.
qualitySale.faq4Q: Can I request upgrades after project completion?
qualitySale.faq4A: Yes — we can help you plan upgrades and refreshes after your project is complete, from hardware swaps to layout enhancements.
